scope: Optional art resources. No shop/equip integration.

porcelain_dynasty.name: Porcelain Dynasty
porcelain_dynasty.description: Ivory ceramic, cobalt botanical scrollwork and fine gold repair seams.

starlight.name: Starlight
starlight.description: Midnight enamel, authored constellations, silver edging and scattered starlight.

grand_prix.name: Grand Prix
grand_prix.description: Navy racing panels, ivory stripes, orange accents, checkerboards and individual hull numbers.

abyssal.name: Abyssal
abyssal.description: Deep-ocean armor, pearl lenses, bright photophore chains and delicate sensory tendrils.

crystalborn.name: Crystalborn
crystalborn.description: Faceted amethyst armor, mint-quartz growths and angular crystal crownlets.

corsair.name: Corsair
corsair.description: Timber plating, canvas fin panels, braided rigging, portholes and broadside cannon housings.

overgrown.name: Overgrown
overgrown.description: Living armor: coral and barnacles on fish, climbing vines and blossoms on birds.

toybox.name: Toybox
toybox.description: Painted tin animals with candy-colored panels, chunky fasteners, decorative axles and a wind-up key.

entries.name: Sardine
features: Paired bright photophore chains fitted to the actual hull
Pearl-tipped sensory tendrils sweep away from the species head
Short swept sensory barbels
Opaque painted and pearl-like accents; no emission or transparency shader

entries.name: Sardine
features: True flat-shaded hexagonal and pentagonal crystal prisms
Paired mineral growths follow the body and preserve the original head
Small flank geodes
Opaque faceted quartz treatment; no refractive/transparency shader

entries.name: Sardine
features: Timber-patterned plating and canvas decorative panels
Four broadside cannon housings with recessed dark muzzle faces
Braided rope rails and brass-rimmed portholes
Triangle faction insignias in texture and raised geometry
Triangle marks on both forward flanks

entries.name: Sardine
features: Original animal hull stays visible beneath living surface detail
Paired branching coral gardens follow the fish shoulders
Raised barnacle colonies with recessed openings
Moss-patterned enamel and restrained warm organic accents

entries.name: Sardine
features: Painted tin panels with warm stripes and cream star motifs
Raised double-loop wind-up key on a short shoulder spindle
Chunky slotted fasteners and red rolled seams
Paired decorative toy axles; all parts are static
Original fish fins and forked tails stay visible

Four broadside cannon housings with recessed dark muzzle faces
Braided rope rails and brass-rimmed portholes
Circle faction insignias in texture and raised geometry
Circle marks on both wings

entries.name: Harpy Eagle
